name: ui-control-find
description: Find enabled, on-screen uGUI and UI Toolkit controls with compact paths, control types, and bottom-left screen click zones. Returns 10 controls per page; pass page to fetch more.

framework.description: Framework scope. auto (default) searches uGUI and UI Toolkit.

controlType.description: Optional control type filter, e.g. button, toggle, slider, dropdown, inputfield, scrollrect.

page.description: 1-based page index. Each page returns up to 10 enabled on-screen controls across all frameworks.

normalizeCoords.description: When true, zone bounds are normalized 0..1 from bottom-left (0) to top-right (1) using the current screen size. Text output uses D.DD except exact 0 and 1.
